firm_data.firm_description: Shinder Cantor Lerner LLP is a full-service antitrust boutique law firm with offices in New York City and Washington, D.C. The firm litigates high-stakes matters on behalf of both plaintiffs and defendants and advises clients on antitrust issues across a variety of industry sectors.
notable_facts: SCL attorneys helped secure a landmark $3 billion settlement in Visa Check/MasterMoney Antitrust Litigation.
SCL attorneys helped lead the Air Cargo Shipping Services Antitrust Litigation, resulting in more than $1.2 billion for plaintiffs.
The firm was launched in October 2024 by prominent antitrust attorneys.
technology_signals: The firm embraces cutting-edge technology as a tool to enhance their legal practice.
SCL uses AI for enhanced legal research, streamlined document review, support to business operations, and initial draft preparation.
SCL exclusively uses AI tools that provide enterprise-level security and guarantees that client data will not be used to train public models or shared with third parties.

ai_contact.ai_notes: SCL embraces AI technology to enhance their legal practice, including enhanced legal research, streamlined document review, and initial draft preparation. They exclusively use AI tools that provide enterprise-level security, dedicated servers, and explicit guarantees that client data will not be used to train public models or shared with third parties.

email.subject: AI for Shinder Cantor Lerner, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Audra,

I noticed SCL is already using AI for enhanced legal research, streamlined document review, and initial draft preparation. That tells me you're thinking strategically about how to compete and scale efficiently in antitrust litigation.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of boutique practices: precision, client trust, and enterprise-level security.

We've completed successful pilots on the East Coast and are expanding into new markets. I'd be happy to stop by your New York office to show how we're helping antitrust boutiques like yours compete more effectively with larger firms.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
